profile.name: Ivo Bubeňko, Ing.
profile.summary: Cloud/DevOps Engineer working on client-facing and internal projects with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure automation. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).

paragraphs: I work on client-facing and internal cloud projects at DevOpsGroup, using AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD. My work includes infrastructure automation, Kubernetes workloads and cloud platform troubleshooting.
I hold a Master's degree in Informatics from the Technical University of Košice. My earlier experience spans frontend and serverless development at ClinBi and SAP ABAP development at Accenture.

projects.title: AsphalesQR
projects.description: Master's thesis project for browser-based verification of digitally signed QR content.
projects.outcome: Designed a server-side signing architecture with AWS KMS and ES256, implemented public-key QR verification in the browser, and deployed the supporting AWS infrastructure and web workflow.

details: Contribute to client-facing and internal cloud projects using AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD.
Work on cloud infrastructure automation, Kubernetes workloads and infrastructure troubleshooting across project environments.
Collaborate with engineering teams and stakeholders on deployment, infrastructure and cloud platform tasks.
Implemented a GitLab CI/CD pipeline for deploying Svelte frontend environments to Amazon S3 and CloudFront.
Automated CloudFront cache invalidation through AWS CLI for repeatable deployments.
Contributed to an AWS SAM / Node.js serverless backend using Lambda and Amazon RDS, including authorization functionality.
Developed and maintained SAP ABAP test services based on functional requirements.
Debugged software issues and performed root-cause analysis, contributing to process optimization and system reliability.
